messages:
tanya: quick one - while updating the audit-exports guide i found mismatched retention field names in the CLI and terraform examples + one terraform example still shows full prompt text. SOC2 will flag that.

yusuf: which names? i saw `expires_at` in CLI JSON, `retention_days` in terraform, and the provider docs show `ttl_seconds`.

ben: suggested canonical name: `retention_days` (int). it's short and matches infra tooling conventions. not tied to timezone.

compliance: prefer wording: 'retained for N days' and add parenthetical 'may be extended for legal hold or investigations'. avoid words like 'permanent'. also: do not include raw prompt text in public snippets.

yusuf: ok. plan: 1) update CLI, terraform, and provider examples to use `retention_days`; 2) replace any `prompt:` or `prompt_text` examples with `prompt_id: "p_xyz"` and a short pseudonymization note; 3) fix a broken link in the onboarding->audit-export section that points to an internal playbook.

ben: also add a short migration note mapping `expires_at` / `ttl_seconds` -> `retention_days`. helps customers migrating between older examples.

security-bot: automated check: remove examples showing full user content. flagging terraform/example.tf:line 12.

yusuf: i'll open a PR to do the changes and add a tiny docs-lint rule that errors on `prompt_text` or `prompt:` in examples. should be a two-line grep and a test.

devex-bot: PR #4987 created by yusuf: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 - "docs: unify retention field in infra examples; pseudonymize prompts; linkfix"

tanya: please tag @compliance and @security in the PR and include the internal retention-playbook link for reviewer context. also include a CHANGELOG line: "docs(security): standardize retention field in CLI/Terraform examples; remove raw prompt example; fix onboarding link"

yusuf: will do. merging once security/compliance sign-off and CI passes.

ben: small but important. prevents bad examples from being copied into infra configs.

tanya: thanks all :+1:

devex-bot: CI: docs-build and docs-lint passed for PR #4987.
